get.summary: Read one artifact of a run, including its payload (view). A `patch` payload carries `diff` as base64 by contract — a patch is arbitrary bytes and JSON string encoding would replace invalid UTF-8 silently. Decode once for display; never round-trip it.
get.description: Errors use the RFC 9457 problem+json envelope on every non-2xx status.

get.summary: Poll a run's events after an id (view). With `Accept: text/event-stream` the same URL answers a server-sent stream instead — snapshot-then-deltas, resumed with Last-Event-ID — and every other Accept keeps this JSON poll. A stream whose principal loses access to the run ends with a terminal frame that carries NO id — `event: forbidden` with `data: {"error":"forbidden"}` — and then closes: the 200 is committed with the first byte, so a revocation can no longer be a 403.
get.description: Errors use the RFC 9457 problem+json envelope on every non-2xx status.

post.summary: Approve, request changes on, or reject a waiting gate (approve grant). The generation in the response is the one decided on approve and reject, and the new one the revision opened on request_changes.
post.description: Errors use the RFC 9457 problem+json envelope on every non-2xx status.

get.summary: Server-sent stream of attention events (gates, publications, run lifecycle) on the projects the caller holds any grant on. Snapshot-then-deltas; resume with Last-Event-ID. Each frame's data: is one StreamFrame and its id: is the resume point. A stream whose principal loses access to what it shows ends with a terminal frame that carries NO id — `event: forbidden` with `data: {"error":"forbidden"}` — and then closes: the 200 is committed with the first byte, so a revocation can no longer be a 403.
get.description: Errors use the RFC 9457 problem+json envelope on every non-2xx status.
